en: Fixed the terminal progress bar showing Claude as working while it waited for your answer or was suspended with Ctrl+Z, and disappearing in Ghostty after 15 seconds while Claude was still working
zh: 修复了终端进度条在 Claude 等待你的回答或被 Ctrl+Z 挂起时仍显示 Claude 正在工作的问题，以及在 Ghostty 中 Claude 仍在工作时进度条 15 秒后消失的问题
